High-performance polymers
for construction.

More durable, energy-efficient buildings need materials that improve long-term performance and sustainability. Synboli offers tailored solutions for these challenges.

Discuss this application

Polymers in
construction.

Construction materials must support durability and energy efficiency. Synboli describes polymer development for additives, protective surfaces, insulation and flooring, as well as polycarbonate glazing systems.

Acrylic polymers and polyesters improve concrete additive flexibility and bonding. PU, silicones and acrylics support durable, weather-resistant coatings. PU foams improve insulation; polyamides support wear-resistant flooring; polycarbonate glazing contributes to thermal insulation.
